# Polish wave, builder C: the app logo and desktop icons (notes for the Director)

Scope kept: `apps/desktop/client/src/shared/brand/**`, new `branding/**`,
`apps/desktop/src-tauri/icons/**` (asset files only), the four HTML heads, this note. No Rust,
bindings, crates, `tauri.conf.json`, capabilities or `src-tauri/src` change.

## Concepts and the pick

Three concepts, masters in `branding/concepts/`, comparison sheet `branding/concepts/compare.png`
(each at 256/64/32/16 on a dark and a light tile, plus the one-colour version at 64/32/16):

| Concept | What | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| A dial | The seal simplified: bezel ring, 12 graduations, a teal deadline arc, gold centre | Reads as a clock or timer app; at 16 px the ticks fuse into a grey disc. Generic. |
| B table | A round table from above: your seat (teal arc), the other side's (coral arc), the deal (gold diamond) between, in a graduated bezel | **Picked.** Says the product (two sides, one deal, you guard it), uses the fixed colour meanings, and the 16 px one-colour form `( ◆ )` stays legible and distinct. |
| C tee | A "T" whose bar is a graduated ruler, coral stem, gold point, square bezel | Clear at 16 px but it is a letter (the brief says avoid text) and reads as a generic tools/ruler app. |

B ships in two weights: the full mark with the bezel (64 px up) and a small master for 16-48 px
(bezel dropped, seats 9 units, diamond larger), the usual optical-size split.

## How the shell uses the icons (read-only findings)

- `tauri.conf.json` has `"bundle": {"active": false}` and **no `bundle.icon` list**, so nothing was
  missing and the file was not edited. With no list, tauri-build 2.7.1 embeds `icons/icon.ico` as the
  Windows exe resource, and tauri-codegen 2.7.1 on Windows takes the default window icon from that
  resource (`default_window_icon_from_app_icon_resource`). So **`icon.ico` is the one file that
  matters today**: exe icon, title bar, taskbar, Alt-Tab. The other files are ready for bundling
  (`bundle.active: true` plus a `bundle.icon` list) and are otherwise unused.
- **The tray icon is not an asset.** `src-tauri/src/native.rs` `tray_icon(dot)` builds a 16x16 RGBA
  gold square in code (plus a brighter square "dot" when something needs the owner), and
  `native/events.rs` swaps it. No file name to overwrite. Using the logo there needs a Rust change
  (outside this package): e.g. `include_bytes!("../icons/tray-32.png")` decoded with Tauri's
  `image-png` feature, or `Image::from_bytes`, with the attention dot composited or a second asset.
  `branding/tray/tray-{light,dark}-{16,24,32}.png` are generated for that change.
- `cargo check -p table-desktop` (via `scripts/cargo.ps1`) passes with the new `icon.ico`: the build
  script re-ran ("Compiling table-desktop ... build script") and embedded it; 0 warnings, 0 errors.

  length), 14 Tauri PNGs at their sizes, cards 1280x640 and 1920x1080. Each ICO frame is pixel-equal
  to its own render (not a downscale).

- Gates (2026-10-15, with A's and B's in-flight files present in the worktree): `pnpm typecheck` 0
